scope: One read-only semantic URL check of existing visible Edge address bar, without launch, navigation, focus/tab changes or CDP. Only a URL matching the authorized target can be emitted.

matching_rules.scheme: http (prepend only when browser display omits scheme)

uia_result.reason: No target match under the documented host/path/database/tab-parameter rules; no unrelated values emitted

limitations: A match verifies the visible address-bar target at this instant, not full page-render completeness or every application interaction.
No unrelated tab titles, addresses or editable values were emitted or retained.
